title: Authority seams with allocator, Queue Fabric, security and consumers
summary: Storage Fabric publishes storage facts and executes storage semantics while remaining authority-separate from Job-to-Node Allocation, Queue Fabric, Access Control/Permissions/Security Effect, Semantic Source Control and Audio/Video domain objects.
invariants: Job-to-Node owns hard eligibility, ranking and placement leases; Storage publishes locality/workspace/movement evidence.
Queue Fabric owns dispatch/delivery; Storage owns transfer checkpoints, verification and commit state.
Access Control and Permissions/Security Effect own authority; Storage route policy is an additional mutation constraint.
Semantic Source Control owns semantic source evolution; Storage change sets own namespace/object mutation evidence.
Audio/Video consume StorageRef/materialisation/workspace and must not make /srv/space, Drive ids or USB mount paths permanent object identity.

provenance.claim: Current package defines authority seams with Job-to-Node, Queue Fabric, Security, SSC, API Client and Audio/Video consumers.
